text:
maya: FYI, noticed a perf regression on Qwen-32h after the Triton 2.1.0 bump. Kernel selection now prefers SDPA for head_dim=48 and we're seeing 2.3x latency vs previous Flash path. attaching quick logs and perf counters. anyone seen this?

ben: ugh, saw something like this on Mixtral earlier. can you paste the kernel decision log lines?

maya: sure, pasted snippet below:
```
[2026-03-15T14:12:05Z] model=qwen-32h v=2026-03-10 commit=abc123
selected_kernel=sdpa_masked
reason=flash_incompatible_head_dim (48 not multiple of 8)
fallback_path=/opt/runtime/kernels/sdpa.so
latency_ms=76.4
previous_latency_ms=32.1
```

sam: quick take — FlashAttention supports head_dim % 8 != 0 with our custom pad policy on older runtime. Triton upgrade tightened alignment checks so selection falls back. we added a conservative reject in kernel_probe.

cheng: @sam can you point to the probe check? iirc we had a heuristic that allows padding up to 4 bytes per head if sequence len < 512. maybe that got dropped.

sam: yep, probe is https://repo/infra/runtime/kernel_probe.cc line ~212. new Triton changed cuBLAS alignment behavior so we treated non-8 dims as unsafe. patch idea: reintroduce sequence-len-aware pad tolerance and KV cache mask sanity checks.

olga: also seeing odd KV cache mask offsets on Mistral configs when head_dim is 48 -> KV stride mismatch + mask shift. that makes SDPA masked slower because it forces dense masking.

maya: repro script i used:
```bash
# repro run-ish
./bin/run_infer --model qwen-32h --seq 256 --batch 1 --max-tokens 128 --profile=cpu,gpu,kernel
```
logs: https://ci/reports/1837654321/artifacts/perf.log

ben: can we run microbench between flash/ssdpa kernels with exact padding applied? i'll run on a smaller instance.

perf-bot: perf snapshot posted: baseline 32.1ms (flash-emulated), triton-2.1 76.4ms (sdpa). detailed table -> https://perf/reports/1837654321/table.csv : cpu_utils 12%, gpu_sm 93%, launch_overhead + kernel_recompile noted.

sam: quick profiling output (nvprof-like):
```
Kernel: sdpa_masked  2.1ms   60% SM  40% mem
Kernel: flash_attn_padded 0.9ms  92% SM  8% mem
Remarks: flash path skipped due to probe fail.
```

cheng: hypothesis: two things combined: (1) probe conservative on head_dim not multiple of 8, (2) KV cache offset rounding bug that flips mask to full dense when stride != 64. both would force slower path.

maya: i tried forced selection override to flash (hack) and latency drops back to ~34ms but we got occasional output mismatch on long sequences (RoPE scaling artifacts). so flash path may be functional but needs RoPE rescale verification for odd head dims.

olga: output mismatch = small token-prob diffs or bigger?

maya: small but cumulative -> sampling diverges by token 8 in some prompts. seems RoPE interpolation math assumes head_dim multiple of 16 in some fused kernels.

ben: plan: (A) re-enable pad-tolerance in probe for seq<=512, (B) add a KV stride sanity check to avoid mask flip, (C) run RoPE numeric verification on flash-attn for head_dim in {40,48,56}. i'll open PR with tests.

sam: also add an explicit kernel compatibility matrix for Triton versions in metric collector so we can auto-fallback only when truly unsafe, not just conservative.

maya: creating a minimal repro + perf traces and uploading to the ticket. cc @cheng @ben for review. PR number when ready?

ben: i'll take the patch review. expecting PR by EOD. linking earlier Mixtral fix that avoided this: https://repo/infra/pulls/4072

perf-bot: nightly benchmarks queued for branch/patch-1837. will post numbers in ~45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

cheng: one more ask — add a test that runs 64-128 token sequences with various head dims and validates top-3 logits within 1e-4 vs reference CPU float32. that will catch RoPE regressions early.

maya: agreed. i'll add test vectors from the original model onboarding.

olga: thanks — if we can keep flash path for prod Qwen and Mixtral that keeps cost down. also please add rollouts: canary for 5% traffic to new Triton probe change.

sam: noted. i'll include canary flag in rollout config.

maya: thanks everyone, will update once PR + perf results land. :thumbsup:
